findings: EmbeddingCache test file defines ten tests for round-trip, misses/order, overwrite, count and eviction using fresh fake-indexeddb per test. No quota/abort/upgrade/corrupt record scenarios.

These tests import separate lib/embedding-cache.ts (gpd-cache database), not main detector inline cache (gpd-embeddings). They do not certify main detector cache lookup/fallback or model invalidation.
Fresh factory per test prevents exercising close/reopen persistence across independent cache instances or migration from old schema.

ActionBar displays caller totalItems as items scanned and duplicateCount as duplicate files; it has no successfully embedded/compared count. Caller total covers fetched/cached metadata, so label does not prove successful detection coverage.
Trash button disables only for duplicateCount === 0; no local kept-membership evidence validation. Actual candidate selection remains caller responsibility.

Debug logging is opt-in via truthy localStorage value or window flag. localStorage exception causes false even if window flag might be set. Theme is static appearance configuration; no deduplication algorithm.
limits: Static source and test review only; no fake-indexeddb/Vitest test run, browser rendering or actual deletion.
23/84 whole tracked files read; no production library code changed.
